SCGSim prepares a geometry and solver request, then resolves the returned results with their units and model identity. Choose a notebook by the quantity you need; its backend tabs carry the procedure from source inputs through result reading.

## Choose a simulation {#getting-started}

| Goal | Notebook | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Capacitance | [Palace Electrostatic or AEDT Q3D](tutorials/capacitance.qmd) | Labeled conductor capacitance matrix |
| Resonant modes | [Palace or HFSS Eigenmode](tutorials/resonance.qmd) | Mode frequencies and returned mode report |
| Energy participation | [Palace or HFSS EPR](tutorials/resonance-epr.qmd) | Surface, bulk and branch participation by mode |
| Driven S-parameters | [HFSS Modal or Terminal](tutorials/scattering.qmd) | Two-port response with the selected port family |
| Transmission-line parameters | [AEDT Q2D](tutorials/transmission-line.qmd) | Per-length C, G, L and R matrices |

## Prepare a model and read its return

Start with [installation](course/installation.qmd), then select explicit geometry, materials, conductors and ports for your physical question. The [model and materials reference](reference.qmd#model-materials) and [conductors and ports reference](reference.qmd#conductors-ports) explain those choices. Use [returned results](course/returned-results.qmd) to keep the returned quantity, units, mode or conductor identity, and solver status together.

## Explore larger examples {#public-inputs}

The deeper Xmon and CPW source notebooks are pinned to public OrPen SC PDK revision [`35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9), which declares OrPen `0.1.0` and GDSFactory 9.48.x. Use the source revision named by each example.

| Public notebook group | Use |
|---|---|
| [Kosen2024_Xmon](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon) | Palace Electrostatic/Eigenmode and source-first Xmon studies |
| [ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | HFSS Eigenmode/Driven and historical Q3D GDS-input source |
| [CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9/notebooks/src/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | Q2D rectangles and conductor groups |

The source dimensions and presets are example model inputs. For current SCGSim requests, follow the relevant tutorial and API references.
